Taper: Zachary Semcken
Source: AKG C414 XLII (Hypercardioid) > MixPre 10 II (32 Bit Float @ 96)
Location: Rear of FOH. DFC, Mics PAS @ ~14'
Editing: WAV > Reaper 7.03 (Gain, Mixing, Normalizing, Resample 32/48) > Audacity 3.4.0 (Fades, Tracking) > FLAC (Level 8)

Huge thanks to Henry Hart, Mark Terrell, and Steven "ZMan" Ziegler for making a great DMB taper section for the tour opener.

This recording is dedicated to all the tapers that have taught me to love archiving live music.
